caption: The video showcases a transparent marquise-cut gemstone on a glossy black surface against a black background, its mirror reflection locked beneath it. The stone's outline and position stay essentially fixed, so the visible activity is the play of light across its facets, not displacement. Bright and dark facets shift in intensity while dispersion flashes of blue, yellow, orange, green, and red appear and fade. Early on a starburst flare emerges at the lower-right edge, swells, then subsides, the reflection brightening and dimming in sync. As it fades, luminance redistributes through the interior facets and reflection. Toward the end a thin horizontal red streak precedes a green flash and an orange-yellow flare at the left tip. The reflection tracks every change, mirroring the scintillation above without the gem itself moving.
